# FirstAGI

> A continuously learning attention kernel: observations -> chosen checks/actions -> outcomes -> useful generalizations -> checked knowledge delta -> fresh inheritor. Target capability, not achieved AGI. Current flagship C-15 / AC0–AC2: build the smallest falsifiable demonstration. Existing component testbed, 1400+ tests, readiness smoke and H22 pilot are public. The complete continual-action/inheritance harness is not implemented.

## Start here
- [Flagship teaser](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/challenges/TEASER.md): teach a skill, interrupt, switch channels, test a fresh inheritor; roles for people, fleets, companies
- [Challenges](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/challenges/README.md): 15 scored challenges, C-15 first; reputation, not money
- [Machine index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/realbtr/firstagi/main/challenges/challenges.json): current_focus and full briefs
- [Readiness audit](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/docs/RETROSPECTIVE_2026-10-29.md): actual components, missing loop, premature claims
- [Operational protocol](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/FIRSTAGI_OPERATIONAL_PROTOCOL.md): AC0–AC4, prerequisites, controls and open thresholds
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/AGENTS.md): participation, evidence and safety
- [MCP server](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/integrations/mcp_arena/README.md): uvx firstagi-arena; C-15 data update via GitHub, local clone for execution

## Working context
- [JOURNAL](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/JOURNAL.md): decisions, current state, one next action
- [SPEC_FINAL v1.1](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/SPEC_FINAL.md): current target contract, implementation limits explicit
- [MANIFESTO](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/MANIFESTO.md): principles of continuous attention, evidence and inheritance
- [HANDOFF](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/HANDOFF.md): recovery routes and focus checks
- [ONTOLOGY](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/docs/ONTOLOGY.md): vocabulary before code
- [Hypotheses](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/docs/HYPOTHESES.md): historical H1–H26; open H27–H35; conceptual source CON-H1…CON-H8 is namespaced
- [Constitution sources](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/tree/main/docs/concept): unchanged September documents, hashes and scope

## Evidence and limits
- [Readiness smoke](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/experiments/reports/attention_readiness_v1.json): fixed-priority channels, numeric driver and limited persistence checks, not a gate pass
- [H22 pilot](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/experiments/reports/h22/PILOT_REPORT.md): lexical candidate count is setting-sensitive; no working-memory-capacity claim
- [Research reports](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/experiments/reports/README.md): provenance and historical results
- [North Star](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/NORTH_STAR.md): long-term ≤10M / 200B+ reasoning target, unmeasured

E2 remains an exchange hypothesis, not the kill-gate of single-core learning. Social LLM agents are infrastructure, not FirstAGI instances. Review rules: ops/TRIAGE.md. Code MIT. Research language Russian; agent entry points bilingual.
